blocks.name: Three-column grid of bordered cards
blocks.description: Six features three across as flat bordered cards, under a centred accent eyebrow and section heading. Each card stacks a tinted icon tile above its title and body copy, and takes its edge from a border rather than a shadow. Falls to two columns at sm and one at base.

blocks.name: Two-column bordered cards with side heading
blocks.description: Four features as bordered cards on a tinted band. The section heading sits left with its call to action opposite on wide viewports, and each card runs a tinted icon tile inline beside the title, with room for a status badge. Two across from md, one below it.

blocks.name: Bento with lead tile and placeholder visual
blocks.description: Asymmetric bento under a left-aligned section heading: a wide brand-tinted lead tile carrying a placeholder deploy-history visual, a tall bordered tile beside it, and two supporting cells. Spans are declared per breakpoint, so everything collapses to one column below lg.

blocks.name: Single-field reset request
blocks.description: Password reset request on a tinted band: envelope mark, an explanation of what happens next, one email field with a privacy-preserving hint, and a route back to sign-in.

blocks.name: Split with framed product shot
blocks.description: Two-column hero: announcement pill, headline, dual call-to-action and a stat row on the left; a framed product screenshot on the right. Stacks to one column below lg.

blocks.name: Media left with email capture
blocks.description: Mirrored split on a tinted band: a placeholder chart on the left, and on the right an accent eyebrow, headline, inline email capture and a trusted-by logo row. Stacks to one column below lg with the media last.

blocks.name: Split with checklist and testimonial
blocks.description: Copy on the left with an accent eyebrow, headline and a ticked feature list; on the right a raised testimonial card floating on a brand-tinted panel. Stacks to one column below lg.

blocks.name: Centred card with social sign-in
blocks.description: Sign-in card on a tinted band: brand mark and heading above, then email and password fields with an inline forgot-password link, a keep-signed-in checkbox, and Google and GitHub providers below a divider.

blocks.name: Three cards with highlighted plan
blocks.description: Three separate pricing cards with a centred section heading. The recommended plan is lifted with a brand border, a solid call to action and a Most popular badge; ticked feature lists sit under a divider and every call to action is pinned to the foot of its card.

blocks.name: Joined panel with tinted plan
blocks.description: Three tiers sharing one rounded panel rather than floating as separate cards. The recommended column is marked by a tinted background instead of a border, so nothing breaks the outer silhouette, and each call to action sits at the foot of its column.

blocks.name: Inverted recommended tier
blocks.description: Three tiers where the recommended plan sits on an inverted surface to carry the most weight, with an oversized price and an annual-billing note under each. Ticks and secondary text adapt to whichever surface the card uses, and every call to action is pinned to the foot of its card.

blocks.name: Centred card with value list
blocks.description: Sign-up card on a tinted band: split first and last name row, work email, password with a strength hint, a terms checkbox, and a short ticked list of what the free tier includes.
